description: This file defines a custom exception class named SimpleBankingGlobalException used for global error handling in a banking-related Java project. It includes annotations from Lombok to generate boilerplate code, such as getters, setters, and constructors, and extends RuntimeException to be used as an unchecked exception.

classes.name: SimpleBankingGlobalException
classes.description: A custom runtime exception class for handling global banking errors, with fields for error code and message, utilizing Lombok annotations for boilerplate code generation.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a specific error message.
